'''Tove Weylan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was defeated by an Imperial strike team during [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra's]] [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|liberation]].<ref name="TOR" />
